Oncall Bot: PAGER: routing-control.high — Dedicated pool health alert (us-west-2). severity=page, impact=customer-requests, reason=heartbeat_missing
Alex K: Acked. I'm digging into router-routing logs and pool health signals. tagging @Priya D @Maria S
Priya D: On it. grabbing logs from the dedicated control plane and checking autoscaler events
Maria S: Any recent router config pushes? I see a small policy tweak earlier but no full deploy.
Alex K: No full deploy. However router config rollback job shows repeated fallback attempts: router.routeFallback.count increased ~10k in last 5m. 503s up.
SRE Pager: Noted widespread errors for some customers (ish). collecting customer list from traces.
Alex K: Key symptom: router misread capacity signal from pool-usw2-ded-42 — health probe returned stale metric `pool_heartbeat=0` while GPUs are actually healthy. autoscaler relies on `pool_healthy` metric; if false, router blackholes traffic into fallback variant, which then triggers further fallback to other regions -> loop.
Priya D: Confirmed. Dedicated control plane shows node agents present, but the health collector job had a short outage and last-success timestamp is ~2m ago. The metric exporter tag was renamed in the last infra rollout: `pool:heartbeat` -> `pool_heartbeat`. The router still reads old tag. mismatch.
Alex K: Oof. So router thinks pool is unhealthy and starts routing to fallback variant `openai-compat-v2` in other region; that region is overloaded and also marks itself unhealthy -> circular failover.
Maria S: Impact assessment: The hit rate of L7 errors (5xx) is 14% for affected routes. Top customers impacted: CustA, CustB, and a batch of small PLG signups. CS notified. Carmen (CS): we started outbound to top 3 customers.
Carmen (CS): Received. CS triage ongoing; customers seeing timeouts ~3-10s and some 503s. collecting logs.
Alex K: Mitigation plan (short-term): 1) Pause smart-routing fallback policy for affected model routes so routers stop cascading failovers. 2) Force the router to use hosted fallback (stable-hosted-1) instead of cross-region Dedicated variants. 3) Patch metric mapping in router config to accept both `pool:heartbeat` and `pool_heartbeat` so we don't lose signal while infra fixes exporter. 4) Trigger manual scale-up of pool-usw2-ded-42 as a last resort.
Priya D: I'll patch router policy now: updating `routing_policies.dedicated_fallback.allow_cross_region = false` for the affected route group. Applying canary to 2 routers.
Alex K: Command I'm running to pause policy (router-admin):
```
curl -X POST "https://router-admin.internal/api/v1/policies/pause" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"policy":"dedicated_fallback","routes":["/v1/generate","/v1/chat/completions"]}'
```
Priya D: Applied on canary routers first, no obvious errors. rolling to region.
Ops Bot: router-policy:update - policy=dedicated_fallback paused for route prefix /v1/generate on canary routers :white_check_mark:
Alex K: Next, force hosted fallback: patching fallback target to stable-hosted-1 via runtime override. Then patch metric mapping.
Maria S: I'll open infra-side fix ticket and revert exporter tag rename back to `pool:heartbeat` for backwards compatibility. Also will add a compatibility shim in the collector for 1h.
Priya D: Manual scale (if needed):
```
curl -X POST "https://dedicated-control.internal/api/v1/pools/usw2-ded-42/scale" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"target_instances":8,"reason":"mitigation - heartbeat mismatch"}'
```
Priya D: Scale command issued, control plane accepted, provisioning started.
SRE Pager: Metrics after policy pause: 503 rate down from 14% -> 2.1% within 90s on canary routers. fallback_count decreased.
Alex K: Good. Keep canary for 10m and then roll region. Also enabling metric mapping patch: updating router config to accept both tags.
Alex K: Router config patch (applied):
```
metric_mapping:
  pool_health_tags: ["pool:heartbeat","pool_heartbeat"]
```
Ops Bot: router-config:apply - change applied to canary routers :white_check_mark:
Maria S: Infra shim deployed to collector, exporter rollback queued for next maintenance window but shim will preserve signals.
Priya D: Dedicated pool provisioning finished, new capacity healthy. Control plane reports pool_healthy=true now for usw2-ded-42.
SRE Pager: After full region roll, 5xxs settled to baseline ~0.6%. No new customer pages.
Alex K: Postmortem notes to capture: - root cause: metric tag rename + lack of compatibility guard in router mapping - contributing: policy allowed aggressive cross-region cascading fallbacks, autoscaler depended on same metric and thus didn't trigger while router blackholed - customer impact: partial for some production customers, degraded performance and 503s - mitigations: pause policy, map metric compatibility, add exporter shim, add canary for future tag changes, add alert when fallback_count crosses threshold and autoscaler not scaling.
Maria S: Handoff: I'm rotating out in 15m. TJ, you'll take the remainder and oversee post-incident follow-ups. Please confirm.
TJ: Taking over. I'll coordinate the postmortem and follow-up action items.
Alex K: Thanks team. I'll open the incident doc and tag owners for each action item. Carmen, CS please keep customers updated and I'll add timeline.
Carmen (CS): Will do. Sending follow-ups to impacted customers and will update the incident bridge.
Oncall Bot: Incident severity lowered to PAGE_RESOLVED_MONITORING after mitigation. Please fill in incident checklist: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1792345678/checklist
Alex K: Incident thread closed for now, moving to postmortem draft.
